crossRefs.note: He brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold, a hole in the wall.
Then he brought me out into the outer court, the way toward the north. Then he brought me into the room that was…
“You shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine…
the hangings of the court, its pillars, their sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court;
That which is left of it Aaron and his sons shall eat. It shall be eaten without yeast in a holy place. They shall eat…
He said to me, ‘Solomon, your son, shall build my house and my courts; for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will…
Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.
but those who have harvested it will eat it, and praise Yahweh. Those who have gathered it will drink it in the courts…

translations.web: He also made posts, sixty cubits; and the court reached to the posts, around the gate.
translations.bsb: Next he measured the gateposts to be sixty cubits high. The gateway extended around to the gatepost of the courtyard.
translations.kjv: He made also posts of threescore cubits, even unto the post of the court round about the gate.
translations.asv: He made also posts, threescore cubits; and the court reached unto the posts, round about the gate.
